summary.headline: The King’s Significator in the Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for a king’s significator in the twelve houses, including wealth, travel, sons, illness, death, authority, enemies, and combustion. The text also interprets direct motion, retrogradation, stations, aspects, conjunctions, and disposition to house lords.
